'''Leaf-tails''' were a small [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].

==Description==
A non-sentient species of winged rodent, leaf-tails had membranous leaf-like tails that aided in balance and camouflage. Omnivorous, leaf-tails ate both berries and rodents to sustain itself. They had expandable cheeks used to gather food&mdash;typically [[Cyanoberry/Legends|cyanoberries]]. They had great agility which helped them jump from tree to tree. Living in nests, leaf-wings attacked in swarms of dozens.<ref name="NoP" /> The rodents were the main prey of creatures such as [[Bogwing/Legends|greater bogwings]].
